summary.text: Ann Flood is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 138 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She founded the Lauren's Hope Foundation.

paragraphs.text: Ann Flood was born in Wind Gap, Pennsylvania, and lives in Bath.
She graduated from Pen Argyl Area High School and earned a B.S. in biology from Moravian College, and she founded the Lauren's Hope Foundation.
Flood assumed office on December 1, 2020, succeeding Marcia Hahn.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Appropriations (as secretary), Labor & Industry (as secretary), and Liquor Control.
